The `redirect_uri_mismatch` error occurs because the exact URL where your app is running (the origin) has not been added to the **Authorized JavaScript origins** in your Google Cloud Console.

I have updated the app to help you fix this:

1.  **Configuration Modal**: I updated the settings window (gear icon) to explicitly show your **current app URL (Origin)**. You can now copy this exact URL and paste it into your Google Cloud Console under **APIs & Services > Credentials > [Your Client ID] > Authorized JavaScript origins**.
2.  **Timeout Handling**: I added a timeout to the authentication process so the app doesn't hang indefinitely if the popup is closed or if authentication fails due to this mismatch.

**Steps to fix:**
1.  Click the **Gear Icon** in the app.
2.  Copy the URL shown in the yellow box (e.g., `https://...`).
3.  Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials).
4.  Edit your OAuth 2.0 Client ID.
5.  Paste the URL into **Authorized JavaScript origins**.
6.  Save and try exporting again.
